name: Abanto y Ciérvana-Abanto Zierbena (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Abanto y Ciérvana (a mine gallery, a tree and a ship).
history: Municipal flag of Abanto y Ciérvana-Abanto Zierbena; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Abanto y Ciérvana arms — mine gallery, tree and ship
